༄༅/ /bdud rtsi ljon shing 'od gsal gyi gnad yig bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: gnad yig bzhugs so/ dngos grub kun 'byung bla ma la/ kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal te/ rdo rje snying po'i zab don mchog /bdud rtsi ljon shing gsal bar bya/ tshe 'di nyid dang bar do dang*/ rang bzhin sprul pa'i bgrod (< a > skur grol ) tshul las/ dang po la yang rnam pa bzhi/ phyi nang gsang ba bla med nyid/ dang po phyi ltar sgrub pa ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas dag tu/ stan la skyil krung legs bcas nas/ skyabs su 'gro dang sems bskyed de/ spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng*/ āoṃ las rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid/ dkar gsal sprul sku'i cha lugs 'dzin/ rab byung khyim pa la sogs pa/ ji ltar bzhugs der gsal btab bo/ de yang skyil krung rin chen brgyan/ ting 'dzin mi g.yo mnyam bzhag las/ mu med 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ bzhad bcas dgyes pa'i tshul du mdzes/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba ni/ dpag yas nam mkha'i dbyings khyab bsam/ phyogs bcu gang bzhugs dbyings rum nas/ de dang 'dra ba dpag med kun/ byon nas gnyis med thim par bsgom/ de la phyi nang mchod pa'i sprin/ ting 'dzin rol mo bsam yas kyis/ gus pas mchod bstod gsol ba btab/ de nas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs/ yi ge gsum gyi 'od byung bas/ bdag dang sems can kun la phog /sgrib byang dngos grub rnam gnyis thob/ snang srid bla mar gyur ba las/ yi ge gsum gyi rang sgra byung*/ 'jig rten g.yo ldeg 'phar bar bsgom/ ngag tu dzab dbyangs snyan par bzlas/ de rjes bdag dang snang srid kun/ bla mar thim pas dbyings su nub/ brjod bral rdzogs chen ngang du glod/ rjes snang rmi lam sgyu ma'i tshul/ dge ba sems can don du bsngo/ 'gro 'chag kun tu bla ma'i ngang*/ bde chen byin gyis rlob par bsam/ des ni ci bsam yid bzhin 'grub/ res 'ga' gang mos gtso bor bsgom/ res 'ga' ma dang bar ma dang*/ gnod byed 'khrul zhing sdang ba rnams/

gtso bor bsgom la gsol ba gdab/ dgyes par bsams la dngos grub zhu/ des ni dngos su 'khon byang nas/ dam tshig nyams chags bskangs par 'gyur/ dam tshig tu ni snang srid kun/ bla ma nyid du mos par bya/ gzhan la ma dad skur 'debs spang*/ gang la'ang bden med sgyu mar sbyang*/ bde sdug grogs su shes par bya/ de yi phan yon tshad med de/ snang srid bla mar 'char ba dang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi ba dang*/ tshe dpal 'byor pa rgyas pa dang*/ dag snang phyogs med 'byongs pa dang*/ gong ma'i byin rlabs 'jug pa dang*/ nyams rtogs ting 'dzin 'phel ba ste/ mdor na gnas skabs mthar thug gi /don gnyis lhun gyis grub par 'gyur/ gnyis pa nang ltar sgrub pa ni/ skyabs su 'gro dang sems bskyed nas/ lhun mnyam stong pa chen po las/ pad zla'i dbus su rang rig hūṃ/ de las rab dkar rdo rje sems/ skyil krung rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes/ 'gying bag mu med 'od zer 'phro/ phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin/ g.yon pas dril bu dku la brten/ thor tshugs padma nyi zla'i steng*/ a las bla ma longs spyod rdzogs/ rigs lnga yab dang yum du gsal/ rnam snang mi bskyod rin chen 'byung*/ snang mtha' don yod grub pa rnams/ so so'i yum dang mnyam pa sbyor/ byang chub bdud 'dul mchog sbyin dang*/ ting 'dzin skyabs sbyin chen po las/ mthing ka dkar ser dmar dang ljang*/ 'od gsal mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku/ stong gsal 'ja' tshon dag pa bzhin/ mu med 'od zer 'phro ba yis/ nam mkha'i dbyings khyab longs sku'i zhing*/ rnam dag stug po bkod par bsgom/ snang srid snod bcud gzugs rnams kun/ rang byung ye shes rnam lnga'i zhing*/ sgra ru grags pa rigs lnga'i gsung*/ 'gyu dran ting 'dzin rol pa las/ mi g.yo chos nyid gdal ba'i klong*/ rdzogs pa chen po'i rang sgra las/ 'dzab dbyangs bzlas shing ting 'dzin spro/ āoṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā/

longs spyod 'dod yon rnam lnga'i sprin/ spro zhing mchod bstod gsol ba gdab/ rjes la kun 'dus chos nyid dang*/ rang byung ye shes don la gzhag /sgyu ma'i ngang nas bsngo ba bya/ dam tshig dngos kun longs sku'i zhing*/ zhi khro nyid las 'da' mi bya/ byams dang snying rje mi spang zhing*/ dag mnyam rdzogs pa chen por spyod/ de yi phan yon tshad med de/ rdos bcas snang ba nub pa dang*/ bar dor 'od gsal zin pa dang*/ dag pa'i zhing khams bgrod pa dang*/ tshogs chen lhun gyis rdzogs pa dang*/ mkha' 'gros bu bzhin skyong ba dang*/ myur du sangs rgyas 'grub pa'o/ gsum pa gsang ba'i sgrub pa ni/ skyabs song byang chub sems bskyed de/ ma skyes gdod nas dag pa'i ngang*/ mi dmigs mnyam pa chen po las/ chos dbyings dur khrod gzhal yas su/ padma nyi zla mi ro'i steng*/ rang nyid chos dbyings phag mo ni/ mthing nag rin chen rus pas brgyan/ rtsa zhal sgeg khro 'dzum bcas zhal/ mche gtsigs mi 'gyur spyan gsum bgrad/ thor tshugs rin chen rus pas brgyan/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar phyar/ g.yon pas thod khrag zhal du gsol/ gru mo kha ṭāṃ dril bus mtshan/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar stabs mdzad/ thod phreng g.yeng gzhi ko rlon gos/ mu med 'od zer 'phro ba yi/ phyogs mtshams rig bzhi'i ḍākki bsgom/ dkar ser dmar dang ljang ba la/ cha lugs phyag mtshan gtso mo 'dra/ ha ri ni sa sgrogs par bsgom/ de lta'i gtso mo'i spyi gtsug gi /phag zhal steng na pad nyi'i steng*/ hūṃ las bla ma chos kyi sku/ dpa' bo kun tu bzang po ni/ mthon mthing mnyam gzhag 'od zer 'phro/ phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi'i bde gshegs ni/ dkar ser dmar ljang 'od zer 'phro/ mi g.yo chos nyid rol pa ni/ nam mkhas gar khyab de ltas khyab/ lhun mnyam yangs pa chen por bsgom/ de dag chos nyid rang sgra ni/ 'dzab dbyangs rang gsal bzlas par bsam/ chos sku'i snying po yi ge a/

dbyangs snyan rab tu brjod pa'i mthar/ āoṃ āḥhūṃ ma ha bha dra a ha ri ni sa siddhi pha la hūṃ de skad bzlas shing ting 'dzin spro/ rjes la kun 'dus skye med dang*/ rtog med mnyam pa chen por glod/ dge ba sems can don du bsngo/ dam tshig kun mnyam yangs pa las/ brtul zhugs rig pa ngar bskyed cing*/ gang la'ang ma chags sgyu ma'i ngang*/ bden med shes pa shin tu gces/ de yi phan yon bstan pa ni/ dngos grub yid bzhin sprin phung 'du/ tshe ring dpal 'byor skye bo 'du/ gegs med bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub/ rang gzhan don gnyis phun sum tshogs/ bzhi pa yang gsang bla med kyi/ sgrub pa chen po bya ba ni/ bzhugs stangs gsum dang gzigs stangs gsum/ bstun nas rang rig 'od gsal blta/ dang po rang gi sna rtse las/ smin mtshams mdzod spu gsal ba'i bar/ rig gdangs dbyings snang lu gu rgyud/ thig le thig phran shar ba las/ goms pas dbyings kyi sgron ma mthong*/ de nyid mu khyud lnga ldan nang*/ 'dab bzhi padma'i lte ba 'dra/ de dbus lu gu rgyud gsal ba/ thabs yin mi 'gul gzer thebs pas/ nang du rig stong spros dang bral/ shes rab rang byung sgron ma ni/ shes rab rtsal dang bcas pa 'char/ de las bde gsal mi rtogs pa'i/ nyams gsum ngang bcas lhug par 'char/ goms pas snang ba rnam pa bzhi/ tshe 'di nyid la mthong nas kyang*/ 'pho ba chen po'i lus bzung nas/ gzhan don dpag med bsgrubs pa'i mthar/ mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i sar/ lhun grun rin po che yi sbubs/ bum pa sku yi zhing khams su/ rgyal mchog kun tu bzang po 'grub/ de ltar dus rnams thams cad du/ gzugs su snang ba thams cad kun/ rang byung ye shes sku dang gdangs/ sgra ru grags pa thams cad kun/ grags stong skye med chos sku'i sgra/ dran rig byung tshor thams cad kun/ rang shar rang grol gza' gtad med/ nyin par snang srid 'og min zhing*/ sprin bral nam mkha'i mthongs su blta/

mtshan mo snying dbus 'od gsal zhing*/ rigs lnga'i rnam par sems bzung la/ rim skyes mi dmigs sbros dang bral/ nam mkha'i ngang du nyal bar bya/ gnyid dang rmi lam 'od gsal grol/ de ltar shes pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ gang na 'dug kyang 'og min gnas/ ji ltar 'gyur kyang ting 'dzin che/ su dang 'grogs kyang rdo rje'i spun/ rdzogs pa chen por lhun gyis grub/ de ni tshe 'di'i nyams len no/ gnyis pa bar do'i grol tshul ni/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' dag /rim gyis thim nas 'od gsal 'char/ de yang rnam pa bzhi nyid las/ dang po nam mkha' 'od gsal thim/ phra rags nub cing 'od gsal 'char/ phyir snang 'od lnga'i zhing khams la/ nang gsal rang rig spros dang bral/ rang ngo shes pas ma bu 'dres/ dus der gdod ma'i sar grol lo/ 'od gsal lhun grub thim pa las/ longs sku'i snang bas nam mkha' khyab/ rang ngo shes pas gdod mar grol/ lhun grub ye shes la thim pas/ ye shes bzhi yi snam bu shar/ rang ngo shes pas dbyings su grol/ ye shes lhun grub rin po ches/ thim pas sku gsum zhing snang 'char/ rang ngo shes pa'i skad cig la/ bla ma dran pas gdams pa dang*/ lha dang lta sgom spyod pa dran/ lam nyid dran te gdod mar grol/ mngon shes drug dang rjes dran drug /thim tshul brgyad rnams rab rdzogs pas/ mi gnas kun tu bzang por 'gyur/ gsum pa sprul skur grol tshul ni/ brtson 'grus tha ma'i gang zag rnams/ de nas shar phyogs mngon dga' sogs/ dag pa'i zhing bgrod pad ma'i steng*/ rdzus skyes rnam grol mchog la reg /'di kun bla ma'i byin rlabs las/ mngon sum stobs kyis 'grub pa yin/ des na dngos grub thams cad kyis/ 'byung gnas dpal ldan bla ma la/ rab dad gus pas brtson par bya/ rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub/ de ltar yang zab bla ma'i lam/ bkod pa che dang rang byung dang*/ rtsal rdzogs rgyud dang 'byed 'grel las/

ji ltar gsungs bzhin legs par bkod/ dge ba de yis 'gro ba kun/ gdod ma'i 'od gsal snying po'i sar/ ma lus phyam cig yongs gzhol te/ sku dang ye shes mthar phyin shog /'od gsal byin rlabs kyi gnad yig /bdud rtsi ljon shing zhes bya ba/ /theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis bkod pa rdzogs so// /dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (10)bdud rtsi ljon shing 'od gsal gyi gnad yig - PAGE 104 -- PAGE 105 - - PAGE 101 -
